title: vagrant up netbsd70 fails on waiting for boot (ssh) but vagrant ssh works
body:
To reproduce, using the following `Vagrantfile`

``` ruby
Vagrant.configure(2) do |config|
  config.vm.box = "netbsd70-0.1.0"
  config.vm.box_url = "http://rickard-von-essen-vagrant.s3.amazonaws.com/bento/boxcutter_netbsd70-0.1.0.virtualbox.box"
end
```

do:

``` bash
vagrant up
```

In another terminal do:

``` bash
vagrant ssh
```
